_oracle_review.note: The original sole finding (a 'concurrent read-then-write race' on a Sui shared object) is DISPUTED: Sui consensus serializes all transactions taking a shared object as input, so the EVM/database lost-update interleaving it describes cannot occur. See platform-quirks/sui.md #1 and refuted/INDEX.md RF-12. It is retained with must_detect=false for documentation. The real, independently-verifiable bug in this code (no withdraw/claim path exists for the accumulated Balance<SUI>, so all deposits are permanently locked) is added as the must_detect finding.

findings.description: deposit() accumulates Coin<SUI> into pool.balance (a linear Balance<SUI>) but the module has no withdraw/claim/split path — all deposited funds are permanently locked
DISPUTED (see _oracle_review): claimed read-then-write race on shared Pool. Sui serializes shared-object access; reframe as cross-transaction staleness of reward_per_depositor, not a lost-update race

false_positive_traps.description: get_reward_estimate() is read-only with immutable reference — no race condition possible, should NOT be flagged
